description: The top-level keys of a positioner entry in a setup file, as imswitch.imcontrol.model.SetupInfo.PositionerInfo declares them. managerProperties is described per manager under managers/. Keys the dataclass does not declare are kept but not read.

analogChannel.description: Channel for analog communication. ``null`` if the device is digital or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/ao{analogChannel}".

axes.description: A list of axes (names) that the positioner controls.

digitalLine.description: Line for digital communication. ``null`` if the device is analog or doesn't use NI-DAQ. If an integer is specified, it will be translated to "Dev1/port0/line{digitalLine}".

forPositioning.description: Whether the positioner is used for manual positioning.

forScanning.description: Whether the positioner is used for scanning.

isPositiveDirection.description: Whether the direction of the positioner is positive.

joystick.description: Whether the positioner is connected to a joystick.

liveUpdate.description: Whether the positioner position should be updated live.

managerProperties.description: Properties to be read by the manager. Empty when omitted.

physicalActuator.description: Identity of the physical device this positioner drives.

resetOnClose.description: Whether the positioner should be reset to 0-position upon closing ImSwitch.

shortcutModifier.description: Keyboard-shortcut group used to jog this positioner from the Positioner widget. ``"ctrl"`` binds the Ctrl+Arrow set; ``"ctrl-shift"`` binds the Ctrl+Shift+Arrow set; ``null`` (default) keeps the legacy behaviour where the first positioner declaring a given axis claims the Ctrl+Arrow set.

title: positioner device entry (PositionerInfo)
